activations.name: Validator seat lock and airdrop schedule
activations.summary: Seeded validator seats keep their one-year lock; airdrop tranches follow the emission start.

activations.name: Scheduled-change safeguards
activations.summary: A scheduled change runs only under the rules that apply to its own operation.

activations.name: Named agents
activations.summary: Named agents with policies, signatures bound to this chain's genesis, and trading safety fixes.

activations.name: Validator self-unjail
activations.summary: A jailed validator unjails itself after its jail period, which doubles for repeat offences.

activations.name: Stake-based emission
activations.summary: Block emission follows the seated stake, within the published yearly ceiling.

activations.name: Validator onboarding
activations.summary: New validators join jailed and unjail themselves; a bench above 21 seats; a voting-power cap; own bonds behind a switch.

releases.notes: Test network build. Every rule listed here is active on the test chain from the height shown.
